decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted has been implemented within three years of the appeal decision dated 17/07/2014.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and particulars: Drawing nos SCC/KHS/01B, SCC/KHS/02B, SCC/KHS/03B, SCC/KHS/04B, SCC/KHS/05B, SCC/KHS/06, SCC/KHS/07A, SCC/KHS/10B, SCC/KHS/22 and SCC/KHS/23, Philips
OptiVision Floodlighting Specification (MVP507), Report from Philips Lighting 'Sports Lighting Proposal' dated 14 June 2013 and Fencing Specifications - extract from Zaun Brochure "Sports & Play Fencing Systems" submitted with the appeal Ref APP/F5540/A/14/2211715.
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on Drawing nos SCC/KHS/03B,SCC/KHS/05B and SCC/KHS/06, the floodlighting columns serving the 3G artificial grass pitch shall be 10m high.

Condition : 4 - The floodlights hereby permitted shall not be operated outside the following hours: 0800 - 2200 Mondays to Sundays, with the exception of the temporary use of the floodlights for a 24-hour period on the night of Saturday, 07/07/2018 only.
Condition : 5 - The floodlights hereby permitted shall be installed and thereafter maintained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars.
description: Variation of condition 4 (hours of use of floodlights) to allow the temporary use of the floodlighting on the 3G pitch and car park for 24 hours on the night of 7th July 2018, of planning reference 01284/B/P23 - approved under appeal APP/F5540/A/14/2211715 on 17/07/2014.
